description.narrative:
Antler EA is applying for support to its incubator/accelerator and implementation of the following interventions during the project period from 2023-2026. Intervention 1 would support Antler EA’s ongoing programs in Nairobi while interventions 2-4 would take Antler EA’s infrastructure in Africa to the next level in terms of reach and impact:
1. Opex support to run and improve Antler EA’s startup incubator programs in Nairobi 2. Additional portfolio support to maximize founder success rates 3. Make Antler’s IP available to the wider African ecosystem 4. Africa expansion The goals of the project are: Increased innovation and impact within the thematic focus areas: climate adaptation and food security in addition to general job creation; Improved access to jobs and income-generating activities: Antler's support and investment in startups lead to creation of new jobs within these companies and income-generating activities for product users with priority to women and/or youth; Improved access to financial services for small- and medium-sized enterprises: Given the importance of financial inclusion Antler will maintain a high focus on fintech as a vertical; and Improved framework conditions for private sector development and investments.
